name: Grilled Flank Steak Tacos with Guacamole, Salsa & Street Corn-Cabbage Slaw (Two Ways)

instructions.primary_message: This recipe was created to feed two adults and two young children. You know your child (their tastes and appetite) best. Use this recipe as a template, adjusting ingredients, cooking methods, and portions as needed.
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, pat the steak dry with paper towels and place on a plate. Season with spices on both sides.
instructions.secondary_message:
454 g flank steak
½ tsp chili powder
½ tsp salt
½ tsp garlic powder

instructions.primary_message: Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add steak and cook until desired doneness, 2-4 minutes per side. Transfer to a clean plate, loosely cover with aluminum foil, and set aside to rest. (Reserve skillet with drippings for later use.)
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 lime
½ small bunch cilantro
½ small bunch green onion (scallion)
1 avocado

instructions.primary_message: Juice half of the lime into a small bowl. Add yogurt, salt, and pepper, then stir to combine. (Reserve remaining lime for later use.)
instructions.secondary_message:
⅛ cup plain Greek yogurt
½ tsp salt
¼ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Halve and pit avocado; using a spoon, scoop out the flesh. Add to the bowl with the yogurt, then mash with a fork or potato masher until guacamole is smooth. Set aside.

Zest and juice remaining lime into a medium bowl. Add additional yogurt, mayo, chili powder, and salt, then stir to combine the dressing. Add shredded cabbage and stir to combine the slaw. Place a ⅔-cup plain slaw on another plate and set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
¼ cup plain Greek yogurt
1 tbsp mayonnaise
½ tsp chili powder
¼ tsp salt
½ (397 g) bag shredded cabbage (coleslaw mix)

instructions.primary_message: Shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add to the bowl with the remaining slaw.
Trim and cut green onions crosswise into thin pieces. Add to the bowl.

Return skillet (with drippings) to medium-high heat, add more oil, and swirl to coat the bottom. Add corn and cook, stirring occasionally, until warmed through and charred in places, 2-3 minutes. Remove from heat. Add half of the corn to the bowl with the slaw, along with Cotija cheese and smoked paprika, then stir to combine the street corn slaw. Set aside. (Reserve remaining corn for serving.)
instructions.secondary_message:
extra virgin olive oil
⅔ cup frozen corn
57 g Cotija cheese
½ tsp smoked paprika

instructions.primary_message: Warm tortillas in another skillet, oven, or microwave (optional).
Thinly slice steak against the grain.

FOR THE KID PLATES: Divide 1 cup of steak strips, corn chips, plain slaw, and corn between plates. 

FOR THE ADULT PLATES: Divide tortillas between plates, then fill with guacamole, remaining steak, and salsa. Serve with street corn slaw on the side and enjoy!
instructions.secondary_message:
1 cup corn chips
½ cup fresh salsa
